name: Box Office
responsibility: Where someone picks an event, books seats or cancels a booking, and reads what happened.

bookSeats.accepts: { eventId: string; seats: number; email: string }
bookSeats.returns: { booked: boolean; message: string; total: number }
bookSeats.description: Pressed once, when someone confirms how many seats they want.

cancelBooking.description: Pressed from the booking someone wants to give back.
